Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the meeting last week — excited to get Cumulus Health into a hands-on onboarding demo. A couple of asks to make the session most effective for your team:

- Can your CIO (or a direct delegate) join the first 30 minutes for the executive context and success criteria? We find that framing the business goals up front speeds alignment.
- If Anna Li (your CIO) is available, we'd like a 10–15 minute pre-brief the day before to surface any high-level security/compliance topics.

Proposed demo windows (all PST):
- Tue Dec 21, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Dec 22, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Dec 23, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, send a couple of alternative slots and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a one-page mutual action plan to help confirm decision owners and next steps.

Agenda highlights: 10m exec context (CIO join), 30m product walkthrough (SE-led), 15m integration discussion, 5m next steps.

Best,
